jobs.description:
**Title****:** Senior Data & Software Engineer (Java / GCP)

**Location****:** Charlotte, NC

**Duration****:** 18 months

**Work Engagement****:** W2

**Work Schedule**: 3 days in office/2 days remote

**Benefits on offer for this contract position**: Health Insurance, Life insurance, 401K and Voluntary Benefits

**Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data & Software Engineer to design, develop, and support scalable cloud-based applications and data platforms. This role will focus on building secure, high-performance data pipelines and software solutions leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Java, Python, and modern DevOps practices. The ideal candidate will have experience developing enterprise-grade applications, real-time data processing solutions, and cloud-native architectures, specifically using GCP.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop scalable, secure data pipelines from on-premise systems of record to Google Cloud Platform services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, and Composer.
* Design, code, test, debug, and document projects and programs associated with technology domains, including upgrades and deployments.
* Build and maintain high-quality, high-performance, scalable software.
* Develop transformation libraries in Python and Apache Beam, including common SCD patterns, data quality checks, and masking/tokenization routines.
* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java-based applications.
* Develop solutions using Java, Spring Framework, SQL, and RESTful APIs.
* Design and support Microservices-based applications.
* Implement real-time data processing solutions using Kafka and Google Pub/Sub.
* Utilize DevOps tools including Gradle, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and solution documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
